id.description: The plugin's id, a lowercase name of at most 32 letters, digits, - and _; a source plugin's units carry it as their provider. Required.

kinds.description: The kinds the plugin's binary serves; each has a table of its name. Required.

protocol.description: The plugin protocol version the binary speaks. Required.

source.description: What a source plugin declares: its codec, its vocabulary, its jobs, commands and tools.

brief_subject.description: The plugin's units may have a brief, whose facts their workflows read.

codec.description: How the plugin's unit keys and addresses are spelled. Required.

fields.description: The pattern of a field, by name, as a Go regular expression.

fold_case.description: Two keys that differ only in case name the same unit.

keys.description: The templates of a unit key, such as "{owner}/{repo}#{number}"; a key is valid when it matches one. Required.

label.description: The template of the unit as a person reads it; empty, or a field the key lacks, reads the key.

target.description: How a command line names a unit, such as "<url>".

targets.description: The pattern a draft target this plugin posts to matches, as a Go regular expression; empty takes none.

urls.description: The templates of a unit's web address; the first whose fields a key has is its address, and an address matching one names the key whose template has the same fields.

commands.description: The commands the plugin binary serves in CLI mode, which run without the daemon.

name.description: The command's name, after the plugin's id on the command line. Required.

usage.description: The command's arguments, as its help shows them.

name.description: The delivery's name, such as "comment". Required.

posts.description: A draft with this delivery reaches people, so it waits for approval.

effects.description: The turn and draft effects the plugin applies through ApplyEffect.

events.description: The event kinds only the plugin's units record.

facts.description: The workflow facts the plugin reports.

dim.description: The fact is a profile dimension.

doc.description: What the fact says, for the reference pages. Required.

enum.description: The values the fact takes; empty takes any.

slots.description: Where the fact is read besides the workflows.

time_varying.description: The fact changes with time alone: the plugin reports it as a temporal value.

untrusted.description: A third party's text sets the fact, so no approval rule reads it.

jobs.description: The jobs the host runs on the plugin through Ingest, by name.

every.description: How often the job runs, as a Go duration. Required.

name.description: The job's name, which Ingest receives. Required.

timeout.description: A run's limit, as a Go duration; empty is the host's default.

kinds.description: The task kind values the plugin's units give their tasks.

name.description: How a person reads the plugin's service, such as "GitHub". Required.

payload.description: The template root of the plugin's turn payload, such as "PR", which only intents of the plugin read.

roles.description: The roles an intent of the plugin may take, each naming host mechanisms.

doc.description: What the role's turns do. Required.

drives_row.description: Its turns drive the row of the workspace they run in.

launch.description: The host launch its turns run, such as "probe".

policy.description: The agent policy of its sessions.

prepare.description: The host prepare its turns run, such as "action:nudge.prepare".

reconcile.description: The host reconcile its turns run, such as "my_review".

round_kind.description: The sweep round its turns are, such as "review".

workspace.description: The workspace builtin its turns run in; empty is any.

rounds.description: The plugin's units count automatic turns per unit, against turns.per_unit_per_day.

row_kinds.description: The values of row.kind on the plugin's rows.

signals.description: The link signals the plugin reports, read as task.link_signal.<name>.

situations.description: The situations the plugin derives items from.

slot.description: The workflow fact slot of the plugin's units, such as "pr"; every fact name starts with it. Required.

tools.description: The MCP tools the plugin serves through CallTool.

input.description: The JSON schema of the tool's arguments, an object. Required.

name.description: The tool's name; its description lives in the profile's tools.toml. Required.
